name: Jeanette Boxall
testimonial:
What an absolutely amazing person and tutor! Suegne has been incredible with Isabel, not only academically but emotionally as well.

She has a wonderful ability to meet a child at their level, understand how they think, and then explain the work in a way that actually makes sense to them. Physics was something Isabel really struggled to understand, but Suegne managed to explain it in a way that no one else had been able to. Her knowledge and teaching of Mathematics was equally brilliant.

What impressed me most was how much she genuinely cared. She willingly gave up her own time to provide extra lessons when Isabel needed them and always went the extra mile to make sure she understood the work rather than simply teaching her how to get the answer.

Suegne made a real difference in both Isabel’s confidence and her schoolwork. She is patient, kind, dedicated and exceptionally good at what she does.

I cannot recommend her highly enough. She is not only a fantastic tutor, but truly an amazing human being.
